synopsis: A few weeks after the Blood Knights’ founding, Falanaras and Theron are well into training within the new order: named, uniformed in black and crimson rather than Silvermoon’s usual gold and crimson, and learning to wield stolen Light as disciplined soldiers rather than traditional paladins. Forsaken scouts led by Serenya Duskrunner warn that Amani raiders from Zul’Aman have deliberately stirred and driven a surge of undead toward the damaged outpost at Tranquillien. Halduron’s Farstriders pursue the trolls while Liadrin sends the Blood Knights south with Lethira’s rangers to intercept the undead before the outpost and its northern road are lost. Falanaras fights as an offensive two-handed swordsman and Theron as a shield-bearing protector, while the order reveals devastating anti-undead force alongside battlefield healing and defensive power. When Serenya’s scouts are cut off, Lethira accepts her old friend’s field judgment and Falanaras uses the Light to cover the Forsaken withdrawal; the Forsaken repay the protection by exposing the Scourge flank and pulling wounded rangers clear. The victory is immediate and unsettlingly effective. Blood elves and Forsaken end the battle holding Tranquillien together without affection or easy trust, establishing a practical foundation for the outpost to become a shared foothold in the Ghostlands.
title: Chapter 12: Blood and Light
